about.metaTitle: About Us | Mozambique Renewable Energy Venture
about.metaDescription: Mission, vision, regional experience and delivery approach for renewable energy, clean cooking and circular agriculture in Mozambique.
about.title: Regional experience. Local commitment.
about.intro: We are a venture dedicated to expanding access to renewable energy, clean cooking and sustainable agriculture in Mozambique.
about.story: The proposal draws on practical experience delivering biogas and solar solutions in Southern Africa while adapting carefully to the Mozambican market. Every implementation should respect local conditions, operating capacity, user training and technical support.
about.mission: Enable access to clean, affordable and sustainable energy solutions that improve livelihoods and support local economic development.
about.vision: A Mozambique where households, farmers, businesses and institutions can harness local resources for a more sustainable energy future.
about.credentials: Only confirmed credentials, supplier authorisations, case studies and contacts should be published. References to Lanforce or Zimbabwe experience should be approved by the project owner.

biogas.metaTitle: Biogas and Clean Cooking | Technical assessment
biogas.metaDescription: How biodigesters convert organic waste into biogas and biofertilizer, with assessment of feedstock, water, safety and maintenance.
biogas.title: Turning organic waste into energy
biogas.intro: Organic waste, including animal manure, can be converted through biodigesters into biogas for cooking and biofertilizer for agricultural use.
how: Organic material and water enter the biodigester.
Biogas can support clean cooking when pressure, safety and volume are suitable.
Digestate must be handled correctly before agricultural use.
biogas.safety: Installation should follow technical guidance, proper ventilation, user training and regular checks. Benefits depend on real site conditions and correct use.

biofertilizer.title: Biofertilizer for circular agriculture
biofertilizer.intro: Digestate generated by biodigesters can support a circular agriculture approach when handled, stored and applied correctly.
pathway: Separation or storage according to technical guidance

faqs.question: Does biogas work in every home?
faqs.answer: No. Feedstock, water, space, safety and daily operating capacity must be assessed.

faqs.question: Do solar systems replace the electricity grid?
faqs.answer: Small home systems are usually suited to essential services such as lighting and charging, according to product capacity.

faqs.question: Are savings or yield increases guaranteed?
faqs.answer: No guarantees should be made without verified data. Results depend on context and correct use.
